notes: Deploy ZeroToOne from src/ZeroToOne.sol with its nonpayable, parameterless constructor. It is the Robinhood LayerZero V2 OFT named Zero To One (ZTO), with 18 local decimals, 6 shared decimals, and zero initial supply. The constructor sets owner and initial LayerZero delegate to 0xcecc29b037f5064fcdf45a5c318f132ef76aa551, independent of the deploying factory. EndpointV2 is 0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B (local endpoint id 30416). The sole immutable peer is the Ethereum OFT adapter 0x68d443f419064b11cc427b9b72faa6c1cedf6378 at endpoint id 30101. Delegate registration occurs in the constructor when endpoint code exists; deployment also succeeds without endpoint or adapter code, and owner-only setDelegate supports later registration. Decimals are constant and no remote token is read during construction. Tokens mint on verified messages from the sole peer and burn on send. No application fees, pause, upgrade path, or rescue function. Required LayerZero code is included under src/. No deployment ETH or initialization calls are specified.
